metadata.measurement: Three sequential fresh processes; warm filesystem cache; Bun transpiler cache disabled. No cold-cache claim.
metadata.scope: Native Trellis CLI only; optional providers, Rust adapter and comparison with alternative TS analyzers are not qualified.

shared-rule-duplicate.purpose: Two owners of the same declared billing calculation

shared-rule-centralized.purpose: Same billing calculation now owned once

independent-similarity.purpose: Intentionally independent domain policies; similar syntax is not by itself a design defect

short-shared-rule.purpose: Repeated ownership of the same small order invariant, below native clone minima

pass-through.purpose: Three delegations without additional behavior; qualitative candidate outside native metric catalog

runtime-cycle.purpose: Two modules forming a runtime import cycle

type-cycle.purpose: Type-only recursive relationship, distinct from a runtime cycle

unresolved-import.purpose: Missing local module must remain visible as incomplete analysis

parse-error.purpose: Malformed TypeScript must not become a clean complete result

mixed-languages.purpose: PHP and Rust files must appear as unsupported coverage

hotspot.purpose: Named complex function for baseline attribution checks

trellis-source.purpose: Public real source tree; not a representative user workload
